subject: english
title: Unit 3: Where We Live & Eco-Houses
subTitle: Lessons 3.1 - 3.3: Homes, Infinitive of Purpose & Modal Verbs

cards.vietnamese: Nhà sàn (nhà xây trên các cọc gỗ cao trên mặt đất hoặc mặt nước)
cards.definition: A house raised on stilts over the surface of the soil or a body of water.
cards.example: Ethnic minorities in northern Vietnam often live in traditional stilt houses.

cards.vietnamese: Nhà sinh thái (ngôi nhà thân thiện với môi trường, tiết kiệm năng lượng)
cards.definition: An environmentally friendly home designed to have low impact on nature.
cards.example: An eco-house uses solar panels and recycled materials.

cards.vietnamese: Tấm pin năng lượng mặt trời
cards.definition: A panel designed to absorb the sun's rays as a source of energy for generating electricity.
cards.example: They installed solar panels on the roof to generate green energy.

cards.vietnamese: Động từ nguyên mẫu chỉ mục đích: Để làm việc gì đó (to + V)
cards.definition: Used to express the purpose or reason why someone does an action.
cards.example: They have solar panels to provide clean electricity.

cards.vietnamese: Rộng rãi, thoáng đãng (nhiều không gian)
cards.example: Their new living room is very spacious and bright.

cards.vietnamese: Rút phích cắm sạc khi sạc xong để tiết kiệm điện
cards.definition: To disconnect an electronic charger from the electrical wall outlet.
cards.example: Always unplug your phone charger to save energy.

cards.phonetic: [Could you tell me the way to...?]
cards.vietnamese: Hỏi đường: Could you tell me the way to...? -> Go along / Go past...
cards.definition: Polite structures used to ask and give directions in towns or schools.
cards.example: Could you tell me the way to the library, please? - Go along this corridor.

exercises.question: What type of house is built on tall wooden poles above ground?
exercises.explanation: Nhà dựng trên cọc cao gọi là stilt house (nhà sàn).

exercises.question: They installed solar panels on the roof ________ energy for heating.
exercises.explanation: Dùng to + V (Infinitive of purpose) để chỉ mục đích.

exercises.question: Which action helps save electricity at home?
options: Unplugging chargers when not in use
exercises.explanation: Rút sạc khi không sử dụng giúp giảm tiêu hao điện năng.

exercises.question: Could you tell me the way to the computer room, please? — ________ the corridor and turn left.
exercises.explanation: Cụm chỉ đường: Go along the corridor (Đi dọc theo hành lang).

exercises.question: A house that has plenty of room and space is called ________.
exercises.explanation: Spacious có nghĩa là rộng rãi, thoáng mát.
